title: Hickory DNS hickory-proto 0.25.0-alpha.1 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 and hickory-net before 0.26.2 contain a logic bug in…
description: Hickory DNS versions hickory-proto 0.25.0-alpha.1 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 and hickory-net before 0.26.2 have a logic bug in the DS-fetch path of DnssecDnsHandle. This bug causes transient DS lookup errors such as SERVFAIL, REFUSED, or timeouts to be cached as Bogus DNSSEC validation verdicts. As a result, the validator returns SERVFAIL for all names under the affected child zone until the cache entry's TTL expires.
